# DevGuard runbook — user_id drift on devguard.raw.users

## Root cause
raw.users.user_id was renamed upstream. The database now exposes customer_id, email, country, signup_ts, is_active; the dbt model stg_users still selects user_id by name, so it fails to build (exit 1). Derived deterministically from runtime evidence — NOT produced by a language model (Diagnostician verdict: REASONER_UNAVAILABLE).

## How it was detected
- [EV-D6103503-001] `dbt run` exited 1 (PASS=1 ERROR=1 SKIP=1)
- [EV-D6103503-002] model stg_users failed to build (models/staging/stg_users.sql)
- [EV-D6103503-003] database reports column "user_id" does not exist
- [EV-D6103503-004] 1 downstream model(s) SKIPped — not rebuilt, not dropped, therefore stale
- [EV-D6103503-005] raw.users now has columns: customer_id, email, country, signup_ts, is_active
- [EV-D6103503-006] MCP server offered 8 tools; document tools present
- [EV-D6103503-018] proposed fix BUILDS in isolated schema analytics_devguard_check (exit 0)
- [EV-D6103503-022] RECOVERY VERIFIED: `dbt run` exited 0 (PASS=3 ERROR=0); previously dbt run exited 1; stg_users failed on column user_id

## Blast radius

- [EV-D6103503-009] catalog schema for stg_users has 5 columns: country, email, is_active, signup_ts, user_id

- [EV-D6103503-011] 5 entities carry column user_id downstream of devguard.raw.users (column-level)
- [EV-D6103503-012] blast radius terminates at registered ML model urn:li:mlModel:(urn:li:dataPlatform:mlflow,devguard_churn_risk,PROD)
- [EV-D6103503-013] column-level path is 5 hops via column user_id
- [EV-D6103503-014] 1 catalog query references user_id (source: SYSTEM)
- [EV-D6103503-019] 1 owner(s) on devguard.raw.users: DataHub

## Fix
- [EV-D6103503-015] root cause (derived, not model-produced): user_id renamed upstream
- [EV-D6103503-016] proposed user_id -> customer_id in substrate/dbt/models/staging/stg_users.sql (2 lines) on devguard/fix-d6103503
- [EV-D6103503-017] patch risk LOW across 1 file(s)

## Recovery, verified
